# Video003 v02 — audit và sửa dựng

## Những nhận xét được xác nhận

V01 là lượt ghép đầu còn dùng overlay PNG cũ (Arial) và quy tắc hiện chữ ở 38% mỗi beat. Quy tắc đó không biết ý câu: có lần chữ hiện sớm, lặp liên tiếp, xuất hiện ở nội dung không liên quan hoặc chỉ còn rất ít thời gian đọc. Việc chia đều mọi ảnh còn đưa đạo cụ rời vào chỗ không cần thiết. Các lỗi này có thật; kiểm preflight và vài still ở lượt trước chưa đủ để phát hiện hết.

## Vì sao giữ những chữ này

Chữ phục vụ một trong ba việc: xác định hồ sơ/phạm vi, nêu giá trị cần so sánh, hoặc làm quan hệ khó thấy trở nên rõ. Những câu chỉ kể lại hành động đang thấy và đang nghe được bỏ. Các chi tiết minh họa hạt lúa vẫn được ghi là minh họa, không phải số đo lịch sử. Các hồ sơ Hugh Miller, Walter Hull, Hugh Cross và Stanton vẫn là các trường hợp khác nhau.

## Kiểm tra và giới hạn

- Timeline: 141 beat, 191 lượt hình, 27 lượt overlay. Audio sửa dài 570.277 giây (~9:30,3); output 720p/24fps.
- Kiểm fit và ký tự trong toàn bộ text native: không overflow, không thiếu glyph Patrick Hand.
- Kiểm mức audio bằng dữ liệu PCM: 9 cửa sổ chứa SFX không clipping; peak lớn nhất trong các cửa sổ mix là -2.63 dBFS. Đây là kiểm kỹ thuật, không thay thế nghe cảm nhận.
- Đã mở rà bảng ảnh giữa của toàn bộ 191 lượt hình và trạng thái hiện đủ của cả 27 overlay, không chỉ vài still mẫu. Đã sửa tiếp nhãn chạm phần đầu ở bữa ăn và cảnh rời nhà. Chữ, mũi tên và nhịp hiện nội dung không còn dựa vào overlay PNG cũ.
- Đã kiểm ba trạng thái trước, trong và sau chuyển hạt. Kiểm dữ liệu bảo toàn 80 hạt minh họa, không trùng tọa độ ở hai đầu: phần giống 60 → 40, phần ăn 20 → 40. Đây là sơ đồ minh họa, không phải lượng lịch sử.
- Chưa có thử nghiệm khán giả hoặc bằng chứng tăng retention. Cần xem/nghe toàn video mới để đánh giá cảm giác, đặc biệt SFX có tự nhiên hay không.
- Người dùng đã chốt v02. Sau cleanup chỉ giữ bản chốt và dữ liệu cần dựng lại; audio gốc giữ nguyên. Chưa tự động đăng YouTube.

            "start": 9248,
            "end": 9293,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "hoping for higher prices later.",
        "section": 6
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V102",
        "start": 9293,
        "end": 9446,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_CR04_03.png",
            "start": 9293,
            "end": 9446,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "From the buyer's side: there can be grain in a store and money in your hand, without grain offered for sale.",
        "section": 6
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V103",
        "start": 9446,
        "end": 9558,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_CR04_03.png",
            "start": 9446,
            "end": 9558,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "This is where “just work harder” stops being a complete answer.",
        "section": 6
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V104",
        "start": 9558,
        "end": 9654,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_CR03_02.png",
            "start": 9558,
            "end": 9654,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "The writer who described the rain also described people dying of hunger.",
        "section": 6
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V105",
        "start": 9654,
        "end": 9763,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_CR03_02.png",
            "start": 9654,
            "end": 9763,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Knowing your work, and being willing to do it, couldn't guarantee enough food.",
        "section": 6
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V106",
        "start": 9763,
        "end": 9834,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV01_01.png",
            "start": 9763,
            "end": 9834,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Suppose you look for a different life elsewhere.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V107",
        "start": 9834,
        "end": 9903,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV01_02.png",
            "start": 9834,
            "end": 9868,
            "scale": 1.08,
            "x": 52,
            "y": 62,
            "motion": 0.025
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV01_03.png",
            "start": 9868,
            "end": 9903,
            "scale": 1.08,
            "x": 52,
            "y": 62,
            "motion": 0.025
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Fold what you can carry into a bundle and lift it.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V108",
        "start": 9903,
        "end": 9952,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 9903,
            "end": 9952,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Your belongings can go with you.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V109",
        "start": 9952,
        "end": 10066,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_03.png",
            "start": 9952,
            "end": 10009,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV03_01.png",
            "start": 10009,
            "end": 10066,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "The crop, the home and the people you know can't all be folded into the cloth.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V110",
        "start": 10066,
        "end": 10193,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 10066,
            "end": 10193,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "And depending on your legal position, some obligations may follow you anyway.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V111",
        "start": 10193,
        "end": 10369,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV04_01.png",
            "start": 10193,
            "end": 10369,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "An earlier court record allowed Walter Hull to live elsewhere after a payment, with other people guaranteeing his obligations.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V112",
        "start": 10369,
        "end": 10416,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV04_02.png",
            "start": 10369,
            "end": 10416,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "His services remained owed.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V113",
        "start": 10416,
        "end": 10513,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 10416,
            "end": 10513,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "New address. Unfortunately, the old claims knew how to find it.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V114",
        "start": 10513,
        "end": 10553,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 10513,
            "end": 10553,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "People did move.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V115",
        "start": 10553,
        "end": 10760,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 10553,
            "end": 10760,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "That record doesn't mean every peasant was forbidden to leave. It shows why changing location wasn't necessarily the same as being released from obligations.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V116",
        "start": 10760,
        "end": 10809,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV03_01.png",
            "start": 10760,
            "end": 10809,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Then think about your next meal.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V117",
        "start": 10809,
        "end": 10910,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV03_02.png",
            "start": 10809,
            "end": 10910,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "If you have work or support waiting, leaving may offer a better chance.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V118",
        "start": 10910,
        "end": 11019,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV03_03.png",
            "start": 10910,
            "end": 11019,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Without it, getting away from this arrangement doesn't yet give you something to live on.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V119",
        "start": 11019,
        "end": 11109,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_01.png",
            "start": 11019,
            "end": 11064,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_02.png",
            "start": 11064,
            "end": 11109,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Look back at the field. It's a source of work and demands.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V120",
        "start": 11109,
        "end": 11209,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV02_03.png",
            "start": 11109,
            "end": 11209,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "It may also be a source of food. Both can be true at once.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V121",
        "start": 11209,
        "end": 11288,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV05_01.png",
            "start": 11209,
            "end": 11288,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "People also challenged demands and defended rights.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V122",
        "start": 11288,
        "end": 11414,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV05_02.png",
            "start": 11288,
            "end": 11414,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "One court case gave Hugh Cross a favourable decision over a disputed bank and hedge.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V123",
        "start": 11414,
        "end": 11479,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV05_03.png",
            "start": 11414,
            "end": 11479,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "A limited victory, but a right protected.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V124",
        "start": 11479,
        "end": 11652,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_MV03_02.png",
            "start": 11479,
            "end": 11652,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "So people weren't simply unaware of their options. The options themselves had conditions, costs and possibilities.",
        "section": 7
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V125",
        "start": 11652,
        "end": 11737,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG01_01.png",
            "start": 11652,
            "end": 11737,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Suppose you reach old age with a holding to transfer.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V126",
        "start": 11737,
        "end": 11815,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG01_02.png",
            "start": 11737,
            "end": 11815,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "You may need another person to take over work you've been doing.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V127",
        "start": 11815,
        "end": 11919,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG03_01.png",
            "start": 11815,
            "end": 11867,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG03_02.png",
            "start": 11867,
            "end": 11919,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Some tenants arranged support in return for passing a holding to a successor.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V128",
        "start": 11919,
        "end": 12036,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG03_03.png",
            "start": 11919,
            "end": 12036,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Depending on the agreement, that could mean food or access to a small amount of land.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V129",
        "start": 12036,
        "end": 12276,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG04_01.png",
            "start": 12036,
            "end": 12156,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG04_02.png",
            "start": 12156,
            "end": 12276,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "One agreement at Stanton in thirteen forty-one gives a concrete example. An ageing couple and their eventual successor were to live in the same house and share their goods.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V130",
        "start": 12276,
        "end": 12422,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG04_03.png",
            "start": 12276,
            "end": 12422,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "He was taking on responsibilities on the holding, with the prospect of eventually becoming its tenant.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V131",
        "start": 12422,
        "end": 12620,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG04_03.png",
            "start": 12422,
            "end": 12620,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "That's a separate recorded case, not the guaranteed ending of our story. It shows a way land and a household arrangement could help provide for later life.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V132",
        "start": 12620,
        "end": 12731,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG01_01.png",
            "start": 12620,
            "end": 12731,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Someone without those resources couldn't assume the same option.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V133",
        "start": 12731,
        "end": 12842,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_01.png",
            "start": 12731,
            "end": 12768,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_02.png",
            "start": 12768,
            "end": 12805,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_03.png",
            "start": 12805,
            "end": 12842,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Now picture our final scene. Somebody else brings a bundle in while you sit.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V134",
        "start": 12842,
        "end": 12972,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_OP07_03.png",
            "start": 12842,
            "end": 12885,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_WK04_01.png",
            "start": 12885,
            "end": 12929,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG01_02.png",
            "start": 12929,
            "end": 12972,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "As a child, you needed looking after. As an adult, other people relied on your work.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V135",
        "start": 12972,
        "end": 13040,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_03.png",
            "start": 12972,
            "end": 13040,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "In later life, the balance can change again.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V136",
        "start": 13040,
        "end": 13158,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_03.png",
            "start": 13040,
            "end": 13158,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "The land that once meant tasks you had to perform can become something you use to negotiate support.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V137",
        "start": 13158,
        "end": 13378,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_CH07_01.png",
            "start": 13158,
            "end": 13231,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_TR01_03.png",
            "start": 13231,
            "end": 13305,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          },
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG05_01.png",
            "start": 13305,
            "end": 13378,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "You learned skills, shared a home, dealt with obligations and other people, and made choices within circumstances you didn't fully control.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V138",
        "start": 13378,
        "end": 13443,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_03.png",
            "start": 13378,
            "end": 13443,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "Peasants varied in wealth and freedom.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V139",
        "start": 13443,
        "end": 13518,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG02_03.png",
            "start": 13443,
            "end": 13518,
            "scale": 1,
            "x": 50,
            "y": 50,
            "motion": 0
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "This was one reconstructed path through that world.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V140",
        "start": 13518,
        "end": 13581,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG05_01.png",
            "start": 13518,
            "end": 13581,
            "scale": 1.08,
            "x": 37,
            "y": 63,
            "motion": 0.018
          }
        ],
        "spoken": "For tonight, let the chair take a turn.",
        "section": 8
      },
      {
        "id": "R05V141",
        "start": 13581,
        "end": 13687,
        "cuts": [
          {
            "file": "medieval/video003/current/scene/R04_AG05_02.png",

            "x": 40,

          }

        "spoken": "Finally, something in the household that improves when you put your weight on it.",
        "section": 8
      }

      "paragraph": "R09P018",

      "spoken_span": "The rest of the crop has not received the memo.",
      "start_audio_est": 155.18,
      "start_audio_word_index": 461,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK01_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 155.18,
      "timeline_end": 158.04,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.86,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 155.18,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK01_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V043",
      "paragraph": "R09P019",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "You give the next bundle your most exhausted look.",
      "start_audio_est": 158.04,
      "start_audio_word_index": 471,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 158.04,
      "timeline_end": 161.32,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.28,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 158.04,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V044",
      "paragraph": "R09P020",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "Nothing.",
      "start_audio_est": 161.32,
      "start_audio_word_index": 480,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 161.32,
      "timeline_end": 162.1,
      "duration_audio_est": 0.78,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 161.32,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V045",
      "paragraph": "R09P020",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "Back to carrying.",
      "start_audio_est": 162.1,
      "start_audio_word_index": 481,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK04_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 162.1,
      "timeline_end": 163.44,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.34,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 162.1,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK04_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V046",
      "paragraph": "R09P021",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "With another person gathering while you carry, you don't both have to stop for every step. You're doing different parts of the same job.",
      "start_audio_est": 163.44,
      "start_audio_word_index": 484,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK06_01",
        "R04_WK06_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 163.44,
      "timeline_end": 170.96,
      "duration_audio_est": 7.52,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 163.44,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK06_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK06_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V047",
      "paragraph": "R09P021",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "In our scene, the collection grows as more bundles arrive.",
      "start_audio_est": 170.96,
      "start_audio_word_index": 508,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK05_01",
        "R04_WK05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 170.96,
      "timeline_end": 174.68,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.72,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 170.96,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK05_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V048",
      "paragraph": "R09P022",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "But having learned to work doesn't mean you can choose every task for yourself.",
      "start_audio_est": 174.68,
      "start_audio_word_index": 518,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 174.68,
      "timeline_end": 178.84,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.16,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 174.68,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V049",
      "paragraph": "R09P023",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "For your adult life, we're following the route of someone who has a holding with labour obligations.",
      "start_audio_est": 178.84,
      "start_audio_word_index": 532,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_OP02_01",
        "R04_OP05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 178.84,
      "timeline_end": 184.78,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.94,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 178.84,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V050",
      "paragraph": "R09P023",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "Not everyone obtained the same land or had the same status.",
      "start_audio_est": 184.78,
      "start_audio_word_index": 549,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_WK06_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 184.78,
      "timeline_end": 188.38,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.6,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 184.78,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK06_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V051",
      "paragraph": "R09P024",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "You might do the work owed, then turn back to your household's crop.",
      "start_audio_est": 188.38,
      "start_audio_word_index": 560,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_OP02_02",
        "R04_OP05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 188.38,
      "timeline_end": 192.04,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.66,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 188.38,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP02_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V052",
      "paragraph": "R09P024",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "Your hands haven't changed. Who the work is for has.",
      "start_audio_est": 192.04,
      "start_audio_word_index": 573,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_OP02_02",
        "R05_HOMEWORK01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 192.04,
      "timeline_end": 195.08,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.04,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 192.04,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP02_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R05_HOMEWORK01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V053",
      "paragraph": "R09P025",
      "section": 3,
      "spoken_span": "That's why finishing one job can leave another waiting. The field that feeds you still needs attention, even after you've supplied labour elsewhere.",
      "start_audio_est": 195.08,
      "start_audio_word_index": 583,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R05_HOMEWORK01_01",
        "R05_HOMEHARVEST01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 195.08,
      "timeline_end": 203.52,
      "duration_audio_est": 8.44,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 195.08,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R05_HOMEWORK01_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R05_HOMEHARVEST01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V054",
      "paragraph": "R09P026",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Come home with part of the harvest.",
      "start_audio_est": 203.52,
      "start_audio_word_index": 606,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 203.52,
      "timeline_end": 205.26,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.74,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 203.52,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V055",
      "paragraph": "R09P027",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Let's keep following the person who helped you carry it. Once home, they turn to preparing food.",
      "start_audio_est": 205.26,
      "start_audio_word_index": 613,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM01_01",
        "R04_HM01_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 205.26,
      "timeline_end": 210.76,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.5,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 205.26,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM01_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM01_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V056",
      "paragraph": "R09P027",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "You bring something to the table, then take your place beside them.",
      "start_audio_est": 210.76,
      "start_audio_word_index": 630,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 210.76,
      "timeline_end": 214.22,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.46,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 210.76,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V057",
      "paragraph": "R09P028",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "The person who took part of the load in the field now passes you food.",
      "start_audio_est": 214.22,
      "start_audio_word_index": 642,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM02_01",
        "R04_HM02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 214.22,
      "timeline_end": 217.9,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.68,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 214.22,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V058",
      "paragraph": "R09P028",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "You take your place in a household whose work you've been sharing.",
      "start_audio_est": 217.9,
      "start_audio_word_index": 657,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM02_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 217.9,
      "timeline_end": 221.18,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.28,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 217.9,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM02_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V059",
      "paragraph": "R09P029",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Put bread beside a cooked meal. Perhaps there's cheese if you have it.",
      "start_audio_est": 221.18,
      "start_audio_word_index": 669,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 221.18,
      "timeline_end": 224.9,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.72,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 221.18,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V060",
      "paragraph": "R09P029",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Evidence from pots at West Cotton points to meat-and-vegetable stews and dairy foods, though that doesn't establish daily meat for everyone.",
      "start_audio_est": 224.9,
      "start_audio_word_index": 682,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM03_02",
        "R04_HM04_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 224.9,
      "timeline_end": 232.78,
      "duration_audio_est": 7.88,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 224.9,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM03_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V061",
      "paragraph": "R09P030",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "You take a mouthful.",
      "start_audio_est": 232.78,
      "start_audio_word_index": 705,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM03_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 232.78,
      "timeline_end": 234.08,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.3,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 232.78,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM03_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V062",
      "paragraph": "R09P030",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Work has produced something useful, and you can enjoy the meal you've helped make possible.",
      "start_audio_est": 234.08,
      "start_audio_word_index": 709,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 234.08,
      "timeline_end": 238.86,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.78,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 234.08,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V063",
      "paragraph": "R09P031",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "But bringing the crop home doesn't mean you can eat the entire store.",
      "start_audio_est": 238.86,
      "start_audio_word_index": 724,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_01",
        "R04_HM04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 238.86,
      "timeline_end": 242.46,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.6,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 238.86,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V064",
      "paragraph": "R09P032",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "In our scene, put aside grain for sowing. Keep food for later.",
      "start_audio_est": 242.46,
      "start_audio_word_index": 737,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_01",
        "R04_HM04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 242.46,
      "timeline_end": 246.8,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.34,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 242.46,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V065",
      "paragraph": "R09P032",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Then remember the claims attached to the holding.",
      "start_audio_est": 246.8,
      "start_audio_word_index": 749,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 246.8,
      "timeline_end": 249.62,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.82,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 246.8,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V066",
      "paragraph": "R09P033",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Hugh's record included payments, grain, three hens and a rooster each year, and five eggs at Easter.",
      "start_audio_est": 249.62,
      "start_audio_word_index": 757,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CH08_01",
        "R04_CH08_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 249.62,
      "timeline_end": 256.12,
      "duration_audio_est": 6.5,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 249.62,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CH08_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CH08_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V067",
      "paragraph": "R09P033",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "Even chickens have made it into the paperwork. Nobody consulted the chickens.",
      "start_audio_est": 256.12,
      "start_audio_word_index": 774,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CH08_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 256.12,
      "timeline_end": 260.38,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.26,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 256.12,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CH08_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [
        "GAG_poultry_paperwork"
      ],
      "existing_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\reused_png\\GAG_poultry_paperwork.png"
      ],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V068",
      "paragraph": "R09P034",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "His lord was the abbot of Peterborough.",
      "start_audio_est": 260.38,
      "start_audio_word_index": 786,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 260.38,
      "timeline_end": 262.82,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.44,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 260.38,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V069",
      "paragraph": "R09P034",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "You didn't need a castle and a sword to have claims on somebody's work and produce.",
      "start_audio_est": 262.82,
      "start_audio_word_index": 793,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 262.82,
      "timeline_end": 267.1,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.28,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 262.82,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V070",
      "paragraph": "R09P035",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "You can see the distinction on the table and in the store: food you've eaten, supplies you've kept, and produce that may be owed elsewhere.",
      "start_audio_est": 267.1,
      "start_audio_word_index": 809,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM04_01",
        "R04_HM04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 267.1,
      "timeline_end": 275.017,
      "duration_audio_est": 7.917,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 267.1,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V071",
      "paragraph": "R09P036",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "If you need more food now and use grain kept for sowing, that can help today's meal.",
      "start_audio_est": 275.017,
      "start_audio_word_index": 834,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM05_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 275.017,
      "timeline_end": 280.237,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.22,
      "audio_file": "Audio001.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 275.017,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM05_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio001.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V072",
      "paragraph": "R09P036",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "It also leaves you needing to replace that grain before sowing.",
      "start_audio_est": 280.237,
      "start_audio_word_index": 851,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 280.237,
      "timeline_end": 283.737,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.5,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 5.22,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V073",
      "paragraph": "R09P036",
      "section": 4,
      "spoken_span": "The pile cannot be in two places at once, however strongly you feel about it.",
      "start_audio_est": 283.737,
      "start_audio_word_index": 862,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_HM05_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 283.737,
      "timeline_end": 288.317,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.58,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 8.72,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_HM05_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V074",
      "paragraph": "R09P037",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "Suppose a cooking pot needs replacing. Its fragments are on the floor, and",
      "start_audio_est": 288.317,
      "start_audio_word_index": 877,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR03_01",
        "R04_TR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 288.317,
      "timeline_end": 292.697,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.38,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 13.3,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V075",
      "paragraph": "R09P037",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "planting them is unlikely to improve your pottery supply.",
      "start_audio_est": 292.697,
      "start_audio_word_index": 890,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 292.697,
      "timeline_end": 296.037,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.34,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 17.68,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [
        "GAG_pot_plant"
      ],
      "existing_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\reused_png\\GAG_pot_plant.png"
      ],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V076",
      "paragraph": "R09P038",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "So a life supported by farming still involves dealing with other people.",
      "start_audio_est": 296.037,
      "start_audio_word_index": 899,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR03_01",
        "R04_TR01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 296.037,
      "timeline_end": 300.537,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.5,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 21.02,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V077",
      "paragraph": "R09P038",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "Households traded and bought things; some also made goods for sale.",
      "start_audio_est": 300.537,
      "start_audio_word_index": 911,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 300.537,
      "timeline_end": 304.157,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.62,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 25.52,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V078",
      "paragraph": "R09P039",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "With equipment, ingredients and customers, bread-making is one possible activity.",
      "start_audio_est": 304.157,
      "start_audio_word_index": 922,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR02_01",
        "R04_TR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 304.157,
      "timeline_end": 310.037,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.88,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 29.14,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V079",
      "paragraph": "R09P039",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "Let's imagine a batch sold.",
      "start_audio_est": 310.037,
      "start_audio_word_index": 933,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 310.037,
      "timeline_end": 311.797,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.76,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 35.02,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V080",
      "paragraph": "R09P040",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "The customer takes the bread.",
      "start_audio_est": 311.797,
      "start_audio_word_index": 938,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR01_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 311.797,
      "timeline_end": 313.417,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.62,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 36.78,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V081",
      "paragraph": "R09P040",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "You receive money.",
      "start_audio_est": 313.417,
      "start_audio_word_index": 943,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR01_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 313.417,
      "timeline_end": 314.557,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.14,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 38.4,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V082",
      "paragraph": "R09P040",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "Before you put it towards the pot, you provide for what another batch would need.",
      "start_audio_est": 314.557,
      "start_audio_word_index": 946,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR02_01",
        "R04_TR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 314.557,
      "timeline_end": 318.777,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.22,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 39.54,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V083",
      "paragraph": "R09P040",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "What remains may help get the replacement.",
      "start_audio_est": 318.777,
      "start_audio_word_index": 961,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 318.777,
      "timeline_end": 321.197,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.42,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 43.76,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V084",
      "paragraph": "R09P041",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "The money has already found another job.",
      "start_audio_est": 321.197,
      "start_audio_word_index": 968,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 321.197,
      "timeline_end": 323.417,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.22,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 46.18,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [
        "GAG_coin_job"
      ],
      "existing_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\reused_png\\GAG_coin_job.png"
      ],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V085",
      "paragraph": "R09P041",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "You were rather hoping it might pay for something and retire.",
      "start_audio_est": 323.417,
      "start_audio_word_index": 975,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 323.417,
      "timeline_end": 326.477,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.06,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 48.4,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V086",
      "paragraph": "R09P042",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "If the exchange works, the replacement comes into your home.",
      "start_audio_est": 326.477,
      "start_audio_word_index": 986,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR03_01",
        "R04_TR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 326.477,
      "timeline_end": 330.137,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.66,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 51.46,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V087",
      "paragraph": "R09P042",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "The fragments can be put aside, and you can return to a familiar task with a usable pot.",
      "start_audio_est": 330.137,
      "start_audio_word_index": 996,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR04_01",
        "R04_TR04_02",
        "R04_TR04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 330.137,
      "timeline_end": 335.277,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.14,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 55.12,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR04_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V088",
      "paragraph": "R09P043",
      "section": 5,
      "spoken_span": "Then a bad year can change what those connections deliver.",
      "start_audio_est": 335.277,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1014,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 335.277,
      "timeline_end": 338.817,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.54,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 60.26,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V089",
      "paragraph": "R09P044",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "Keep that ordinary scene in mind: work, exchange, food brought home.",
      "start_audio_est": 338.817,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1024,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_TR01_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 338.817,
      "timeline_end": 344.217,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.4,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 63.8,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_TR01_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V090",
      "paragraph": "R09P045",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "Now compare it with the famine that began in thirteen fifteen.",
      "start_audio_est": 344.217,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1035,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR05_01",
        "R04_CR05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 344.217,
      "timeline_end": 348.037,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.82,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 69.2,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR05_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V091",
      "paragraph": "R09P045",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "This was a crisis, not an ordinary year repeated throughout our character's life.",
      "start_audio_est": 348.037,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1046,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR05_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 348.037,
      "timeline_end": 353.097,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.06,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 73.02,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR05_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V092",
      "paragraph": "R09P046",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "A writer at the time described heavy rain preventing grain from ripening and making harvesting difficult.",
      "start_audio_est": 353.097,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1059,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR05_01",
        "R04_CR05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 353.097,
      "timeline_end": 359.117,
      "duration_audio_est": 6.02,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 78.08,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR05_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V093",
      "paragraph": "R09P047",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "Suppose your supplies fall short and you find paid work.",
      "start_audio_est": 359.117,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1075,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 359.117,
      "timeline_end": 362.177,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.06,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 84.1,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V094",
      "paragraph": "R09P047",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "You earn money and go to buy food.",
      "start_audio_est": 362.177,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1085,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR01_02",
        "R04_CR02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 362.177,
      "timeline_end": 364.917,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.74,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 87.16,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR01_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V095",
      "paragraph": "R09P047",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "During the famine, wages could rise while grain prices rose faster.",
      "start_audio_est": 364.917,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1093,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 364.917,
      "timeline_end": 369.317,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.4,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 89.9,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V096",
      "paragraph": "R09P047",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "More money could buy less grain.",
      "start_audio_est": 369.317,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1104,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR02_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 369.317,
      "timeline_end": 371.397,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.08,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 94.3,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR02_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V097",
      "paragraph": "R09P048",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "You are chasing dinner. Dinner has picked up speed.",
      "start_audio_est": 371.397,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1110,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR02_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 371.397,
      "timeline_end": 374.717,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.32,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 96.38,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR02_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [
        "GAG_dinner_run"
      ],
      "existing_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\reused_png\\GAG_dinner_run.png"
      ],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V098",
      "paragraph": "R09P049",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "The routine looks familiar. The result doesn't:",
      "start_audio_est": 374.717,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1119,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR03_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 374.717,
      "timeline_end": 377.577,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.86,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 99.7,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR03_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V099",
      "paragraph": "R09P049",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "what you can bring home may no longer cover the shortage.",
      "start_audio_est": 377.577,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1126,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 377.577,
      "timeline_end": 380.977,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.4,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 102.56,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V100",
      "paragraph": "R09P050",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "In April thirteen sixteen, the king complained that some people with large grain stocks were holding them back from sale,",
      "start_audio_est": 380.977,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1137,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR04_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 380.977,
      "timeline_end": 387.497,
      "duration_audio_est": 6.52,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 105.96,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR04_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V101",
      "paragraph": "R09P050",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "hoping for higher prices later.",
      "start_audio_est": 387.497,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1157,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 387.497,
      "timeline_end": 389.357,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.86,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 112.48,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V102",
      "paragraph": "R09P051",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "From the buyer's side: there can be grain in a store and money in your hand, without grain offered for sale.",
      "start_audio_est": 389.357,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1162,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 389.357,
      "timeline_end": 395.757,
      "duration_audio_est": 6.4,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 114.34,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V103",
      "paragraph": "R09P052",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "This is where “just work harder” stops being a complete answer.",
      "start_audio_est": 395.757,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1183,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 395.757,
      "timeline_end": 400.417,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.66,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 120.74,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V104",
      "paragraph": "R09P052",
      "section": 6,
