      "spoken_span": "The writer who described the rain also described people dying of hunger.",
      "start_audio_est": 400.417,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1194,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 400.417,
      "timeline_end": 404.397,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.98,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 125.4,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V105",
      "paragraph": "R09P053",
      "section": 6,
      "spoken_span": "Knowing your work, and being willing to do it, couldn't guarantee enough food.",
      "start_audio_est": 404.397,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1206,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_CR03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 404.397,
      "timeline_end": 408.937,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.54,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 129.38,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_CR03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V106",
      "paragraph": "R09P054",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Suppose you look for a different life elsewhere.",
      "start_audio_est": 408.937,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1219,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 408.937,
      "timeline_end": 411.917,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.98,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 133.92,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V107",
      "paragraph": "R09P054",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Fold what you can carry into a bundle and lift it.",
      "start_audio_est": 411.917,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1227,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV01_02",
        "R04_MV01_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 411.917,
      "timeline_end": 414.767,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.85,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 136.9,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV01_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV01_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V108",
      "paragraph": "R09P055",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Your belongings can go with you.",
      "start_audio_est": 414.767,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1238,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 414.767,
      "timeline_end": 416.837,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.07,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 139.75,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V109",
      "paragraph": "R09P055",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "The crop, the home and the people you know can't all be folded into the cloth.",
      "start_audio_est": 416.837,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1244,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_03",
        "R04_MV03_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 416.837,
      "timeline_end": 421.577,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.74,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 141.82,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_03.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV03_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V110",
      "paragraph": "R09P056",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "And depending on your legal position, some obligations may follow you anyway.",
      "start_audio_est": 421.577,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1260,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 421.577,
      "timeline_end": 426.857,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.28,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 146.56,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V111",
      "paragraph": "R09P057",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "An earlier court record allowed Walter Hull to live elsewhere after a payment, with other people guaranteeing his obligations.",
      "start_audio_est": 426.857,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1272,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV04_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 426.857,
      "timeline_end": 434.177,
      "duration_audio_est": 7.32,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 151.84,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV04_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V112",
      "paragraph": "R09P057",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "His services remained owed.",
      "start_audio_est": 434.177,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1291,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 434.177,
      "timeline_end": 436.157,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.98,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 159.16,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V113",
      "paragraph": "R09P058",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "New address. Unfortunately, the old claims knew how to find it.",
      "start_audio_est": 436.157,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1295,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 436.157,
      "timeline_end": 440.217,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.06,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 161.14,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V114",
      "paragraph": "R09P059",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "People did move.",
      "start_audio_est": 440.217,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1306,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 440.217,
      "timeline_end": 441.877,
      "duration_audio_est": 1.66,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 165.2,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V115",
      "paragraph": "R09P059",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "That record doesn't mean every peasant was forbidden to leave. It shows why changing location wasn't necessarily the same as being released from obligations.",
      "start_audio_est": 441.877,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1309,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 441.877,
      "timeline_end": 450.477,
      "duration_audio_est": 8.6,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 166.86,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V116",
      "paragraph": "R09P060",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Then think about your next meal.",
      "start_audio_est": 450.477,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1333,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV03_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 450.477,
      "timeline_end": 452.517,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.04,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 175.46,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV03_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V117",
      "paragraph": "R09P060",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "If you have work or support waiting, leaving may offer a better chance.",
      "start_audio_est": 452.517,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1339,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 452.517,
      "timeline_end": 456.737,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.22,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 177.5,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V118",
      "paragraph": "R09P060",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Without it, getting away from this arrangement doesn't yet give you something to live on.",
      "start_audio_est": 456.737,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1352,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV03_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 456.737,
      "timeline_end": 461.297,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.56,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 181.72,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV03_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V119",
      "paragraph": "R09P061",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "Look back at the field. It's a source of work and demands.",
      "start_audio_est": 461.297,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1367,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_01",
        "R04_MV02_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 461.297,
      "timeline_end": 465.037,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.74,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 186.28,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V120",
      "paragraph": "R09P061",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "It may also be a source of food. Both can be true at once.",
      "start_audio_est": 465.037,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1379,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV02_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 465.037,
      "timeline_end": 469.207,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.17,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 190.02,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV02_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V121",
      "paragraph": "R09P062",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "People also challenged demands and defended rights.",
      "start_audio_est": 469.207,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1393,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV05_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 469.207,
      "timeline_end": 472.497,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.29,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 194.19,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV05_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V122",
      "paragraph": "R09P062",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "One court case gave Hugh Cross a favourable decision over a disputed bank and hedge.",
      "start_audio_est": 472.497,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1400,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV05_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 472.497,
      "timeline_end": 477.757,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.26,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 197.48,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV05_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V123",
      "paragraph": "R09P062",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "A limited victory, but a right protected.",
      "start_audio_est": 477.757,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1415,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV05_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 477.757,
      "timeline_end": 480.437,
      "duration_audio_est": 2.68,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 202.74,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV05_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V124",
      "paragraph": "R09P063",
      "section": 7,
      "spoken_span": "So people weren't simply unaware of their options. The options themselves had conditions, costs and possibilities.",
      "start_audio_est": 480.437,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1422,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_MV03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 480.437,
      "timeline_end": 487.657,
      "duration_audio_est": 7.22,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 205.42,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_MV03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V125",
      "paragraph": "R09P064",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "Suppose you reach old age with a holding to transfer.",
      "start_audio_est": 487.657,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1438,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 487.657,
      "timeline_end": 491.197,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.54,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 212.64,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V126",
      "paragraph": "R09P064",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "You may need another person to take over work you've been doing.",
      "start_audio_est": 491.197,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1448,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG01_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 491.197,
      "timeline_end": 494.437,
      "duration_audio_est": 3.24,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 216.18,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG01_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V127",
      "paragraph": "R09P065",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "Some tenants arranged support in return for passing a holding to a successor.",
      "start_audio_est": 494.437,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1460,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG03_01",
        "R04_AG03_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 494.437,
      "timeline_end": 498.777,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.34,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 219.42,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG03_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG03_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V128",
      "paragraph": "R09P065",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "Depending on the agreement, that could mean food or access to a small amount of land.",
      "start_audio_est": 498.777,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1473,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG03_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 498.777,
      "timeline_end": 503.637,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.86,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 223.76,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG03_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V129",
      "paragraph": "R09P066",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "One agreement at Stanton in thirteen forty-one gives a concrete example. An ageing couple and their eventual successor were to live in the same house and share their goods.",
      "start_audio_est": 503.637,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1489,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG04_01",
        "R04_AG04_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 503.637,
      "timeline_end": 513.637,
      "duration_audio_est": 10.0,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 228.62,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG04_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V130",
      "paragraph": "R09P066",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "He was taking on responsibilities on the holding, with the prospect of eventually becoming its tenant.",
      "start_audio_est": 513.637,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1519,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 513.637,
      "timeline_end": 519.737,
      "duration_audio_est": 6.1,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 238.62,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V131",
      "paragraph": "R09P067",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "That's a separate recorded case, not the guaranteed ending of our story. It shows a way land and a household arrangement could help provide for later life.",
      "start_audio_est": 519.737,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1535,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG04_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 519.737,
      "timeline_end": 527.977,
      "duration_audio_est": 8.24,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 244.72,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG04_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V132",
      "paragraph": "R09P067",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "Someone without those resources couldn't assume the same option.",
      "start_audio_est": 527.977,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1562,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG01_01"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 527.977,
      "timeline_end": 532.617,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.64,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 252.96,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG01_01.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V133",
      "paragraph": "R09P068",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "Now picture our final scene. Somebody else brings a bundle in while you sit.",
      "start_audio_est": 532.617,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1571,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_AG02_01",
        "R04_AG02_02",
        "R04_AG02_03"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 532.617,
      "timeline_end": 537.237,
      "duration_audio_est": 4.62,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 257.6,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG02_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG02_02.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG02_03.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V134",
      "paragraph": "R09P068",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "As a child, you needed looking after. As an adult, other people relied on your work.",
      "start_audio_est": 537.237,
      "start_audio_word_index": 1585,
      "word_match_exact": true,
      "scene_png_ids": [
        "R04_OP07_03",
        "R04_WK04_01",
        "R04_AG01_02"
      ],
      "prop_layer_ids": [],
      "timeline_start": 537.237,
      "timeline_end": 542.637,
      "duration_audio_est": 5.4,
      "audio_file": "Audio002.mp3",
      "audio_local_start": 262.22,
      "scene_files": [
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_OP07_03.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_WK04_01.png",
        "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\03_ASSETS\\scene_png\\R04_AG01_02.png"
      ],
      "prop_files": [],
      "existing_asset_ids": [],
      "existing_files": [],
      "audio_path": "D:\\Youtube\\Medieval Life Explained\\videos\\Video003\\Audio\\Audio002.mp3"
    },
    {
      "id": "R05V135",
      "paragraph": "R09P068",
      "section": 8,
      "spoken_span": "In later life, the balance can change again.",
      "start_audio_est": 542.637,
